cases.title: Tester-case catalog foundation
profiles: Clean source checkout with Python 3; no ROM, emulator, artifact, or optional feature profile
cases.purpose: Exercise the stable catalog schema and checker integration that future feature cases extend.
cases.prerequisites: Start from the repository root with docs/test-cases and scripts/check_docs.py present; no save state is needed.
cases.actions: Inspect the catalog index, template, and registry; run the focused docs-checker unit test and the checker command named below.
cases.expected_result: The registry exposes separate feature and case records, the procedure is indexed, and both commands accept the valid foundation data.
cases.negative_control: Focused fixtures reject malformed or duplicate IDs, unknown ownership, missing links or anchors, placeholders, unnamed automation, missing exclusion rationale, and a missing complete-mode feature.
cases.interactions: Depends on issue #53's tester-case contract. The feature backfill is deliberately deferred to issues #55 through #58.
cases.save_compatibility: No save bytes, migration, compatibility epoch, or runtime profile changes.
cases.cleanup: No cleanup is required.
cases.limitations: This foundation validates the schema and extension seam only; it does not yet assert full current-feature coverage.

cases.title: Mechanics registry applies ordered, bounded hooks
profiles: Modern AAPCS release starter profile with mechanics hooks and sample enabled
Modern AAPCS default profile with mechanics hooks disabled

cases.expected_result: The registry is ordered, accepts eight entries, refuses the ninth, the enabled real bout reports the documented counters and +1 defence delta, and invalid dependencies fail before compilation.
cases.negative_control: The flags-off host and ROM paths leave all hook state inert and preserve the same resolved vanilla battle.
cases.interactions: The sample and starter content require hooks; danger, casual, and AoE are independent.
cases.save_compatibility: Diagnostic fingerprint only; no save field, layout, migration, or compatibility-epoch change.
cases.cleanup: Use make clean_fast only to remove artifacts.
cases.limitations: The registry is a battle-stat seam, not a content catalog, option menu, or persisted setting.

cases.title: Custom spell dispatch completes one bounded effect
profiles: Isolated modern AAPCS debug test ROM with EXPANSION_CUSTOM_SPELL_EFFECTS=1
Isolated modern AAPCS release test ROM with EXPANSION_CUSTOM_SPELL_EFFECTS=1
cases.purpose: Exercise the public StartSpellAnimation dispatch ABI, typed descriptor, timing, hit, resource ownership, and cleanup on real libmGBA.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with arm-none-eabi GCC, libmGBA, and distinct issue-77 build roots; no save, chapter, event script, or external package.
cases.actions: Run the custom-spell host suite, then the documented enabled debug and release expansion-modern-custom-spell-check commands.
cases.expected_result: The registered 0x80 descriptor starts once, uploads all six visual resources exactly once per frame (two complete sets), plays every ordered boundary sound, applies one hit, keeps the final child for its last display tick, creates and deletes one child, cleans once, and leaves no owner, semaphore, spell-cast Proc, or active spell state.
cases.negative_control: The same ROM dispatches vanilla index 24 through the unchanged LUT without incrementing the custom-dispatch counter.
cases.interactions: Depends on the existing C05/StartSpellAnimation, spell-FX, Proc, and presentation-policy seams; #78 is the sole dependent adapter. No starter, casual, AoE, localization, or BGM dependency.
cases.save_compatibility: The isolated effect ends with zero transient ownership and introduces no save field, item encoding, migration, or epoch change.
cases.cleanup: Remove only the named build/issue77-*-enabled roots if artifacts are no longer needed.
cases.limitations: The foundation descriptor reuses bounded vanilla Fire assets; package parsing and generated project bindings belong to #78.

cases.title: Custom spell conflicts fall back without leaking resources
profiles: Isolated modern AAPCS debug and release test ROMs with EXPANSION_CUSTOM_SPELL_EFFECTS=1
cases.purpose: Exercise missing and invalid descriptors, reentrancy, a post-acquisition failure, WITH_BACKGROUNDS, a foreign semaphore, and forced owner termination.
cases.prerequisites: Use a fresh enabled issue-77 test root; the test ROM supplies only bounded Anim fixtures and scalar probes.
cases.actions: Run either documented enabled custom-spell check and inspect its semantic probe result.
cases.expected_result: Every conflict records the exact fallback reason and vanilla fallback 22 before unsafe allocation; reentrancy starts only one owner; injected post-acquisition failure and forced end clean once; foreign semaphore value 1 is preserved; final ownership is zero.
cases.negative_control: The normal DEFAULT-policy case in the same run acquires resources and completes one custom effect.
cases.interactions: WITH_BACKGROUNDS is an explicit runtime conflict. DEFAULT, REDUCED, and SOLO remain admissible when their published OAM/VRAM budgets fit.
cases.save_compatibility: All failure and cleanup paths are transient and finish before any normal save boundary.
cases.cleanup: No fixture reset is needed; the harness resets counters and verifies zero state between cases.
cases.limitations: The fault selector exists only behind FE8_EXPANSION_CUSTOM_SPELL_TEST and cannot be enabled by a production configure profile.
